Pletor MCP combined with your catalog creates an agent that boosts conversions by over 30% by automatically generating product videos for every SKU. 

Many ecommerce brands still operate with a pre-AI mindset, relying on static packshots and perhaps one lifestyle image. 

Transform every product into dynamic marketing directly from Claude. Now, every product detail page (PDP) can instantly become:
• a mini fashion shoot
• a product demo
• a showcase of every colorway
• targeted for every persona
• localized creative at scale

Eliminate the back-and-forth with production teams and the lengthy wait for new assets. I used Stately for my inspiration.

This approach is particularly effective for fashion, cosmetics, supplements, and consumer brands with extensive catalogs. 

Interested in the full setup? Comment "MCP" and I will provide the plug-and-play playbook and setup guide.

GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2 = Incredible video ads. This is a spec one for Stately.

It makes your video workflows faster, cheaper, and more scalable.

That’s one of the best AI tricks I’ve discovered recently.

And I’m sharing it with you:

1)Brief + packshot.
You give the workflow your creative brief and your product image.

2) GPT Image 2 builds your storyboard.
It creates it frame by frame and shows it in one image. You review every shot before a single video credit gets spent.

3) Seedance 2 takes the storyboard and generates the video. The storyboard is the prompt. Each frame becomes a video clip. The model knows exactly what you want because you designed it with unmatched precision.

The result: a video ad where every frame was intentional.
No guessing. No credit waste. No "let's try again."

Comment "Storyboard" and I'll send you the workflow.
